subject: Data Engineering
title: Data Formats for the Cloud
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Data Formats for the Cloud.

hook.text: Storing data as CSV on S3 works. But querying a terabyte CSV file is painfully slow. Format matters.

buildup.text: Columnar formats like Parquet store data by column, enabling engines to read only the columns needed.

discovery.text: Parquet adds compression, schema metadata, and predicate pushdown — turning dumb files into smart storage.

twist.text: Avro is better for row-level streaming writes. The right format depends on your read and write patterns.

climax.text: Choosing the right file format can make cloud queries 10x faster and 5x cheaper without any code changes.

punchline.text: The format is the first optimization. Choose it wisely.

quiz.question: Why are columnar formats like Parquet efficient for analytics?
options: They allow reading only the needed columns
They store data as plain text
They compress better than any other format
